text:
liam: sketching an approach for cost-safe spot overflow — calling it 'ephemeral lanes' + credit-bucket. idea: keep a small reserved on-demand baseline per-az for steady qps, but allow a pool of ephemeral preemptible lanes that draw from a token bucket. when bucket>0, jobs can route to ephemeral lanes; on preempt, we refund credits and optionally requeue. goal: reduce sustained on-demand while keeping tail latency bounded. :thinking:

maya: can you show how credits are consumed and refunded during partial evictions?

liam: short example: credits charged at allocation (size * time_estimate). if instance preempts early we calculate used_time and refund unused portion back to bucket. also set max-drain-time to avoid long-tail requeue storms.

kenny: can we avoid thundering requeues when a whole AZ gets reclaimed? what triggers auto-shrink?

liam: plan: multi-signal eviction handler. if 1 instance preempts -> refund + retry. if >=20% of ephemeral lane capacity in AZ preempts within 2m -> backoff route, pause ephemeral lanes for that AZ and divert to on-demand or neighboring AZs. also cap simultaneous retries per tenant.

kenny: nice. also suggest add a soft-commit for warmup: ephemeral lanes can pre-warm lightweight containers (no model weights) then grab weights when credits available. reduces cold-start cost.

sasha: regional constraints: some regions have tiny on-demand pools and limited spot supply. prefer cross-az fallback only if network egress/latency budget allows. we should surface estimated p99 extra latency in console before routing.

liam: agreed. we'll expose a per-route "ephemeral-risk" score and estimated latency delta. also add an opt-out flag for tenants with strict locality.

kenny: config sketch (will iterate):
```yaml
ephemeral_lanes:
  enabled: true
  per_az_min_on_demand: 2
  bucket_capacity: 1000   # credits
  charge_rate: 1          # credits per vGPU-minute
  max_parallel_retries: 5
  az_surge_threshold_pct: 20
  az_surge_window_secs: 120
  backoff_duration_secs: 300
  prewarm_mode: lightweight  # "none" | "lightweight" | "full"
```

maya: metrics we need: credits_used, credits_refunded, az_surge_events, retry_failures, p99_tail_latency_ephemeral, reroute_rate, cost_delta_on_demand_vs_ephemeral. add alert if refund_rate < 80% (means we're over-allocating).

capacity-bot: [alert simulation] ephemeral_lanes.az_surge_events high in us-west-2 (22 events in 3m) — recommending temporary pause.

liam: thanks @capacity-bot :eyes: i'll spin up a PoC with canary traffic (10% traffic to ephemeral lanes) and add the metrics. ticketed as INF-4721, assigned to me. next steps: implement refund math, add console risk score, and run 24h soak in us-west-2 only.

sasha: thumbs if you approve canary in us-west-2 :thumbsup:

kenny: :thumbsup:
